name: refuse-union-grazing-domes
why: Two domes whose flat feet overlap by 0.36 mm, unioned onto a plate: the fuse returned a watertight solid with one dome missing (1643.64 mm³, 7 faces, where both give about 1687 and 8) and raised no alert. A planter saucer lost 19 of 48 such bumps, and a denser layout lost the dish. Every point of an input's faces must be inside or on the union; the refusal names the lost input and the fix.
